item.title: Sports Desk · Monday beat — closing the Thursday-to-Monday cadence
item.description: Third leg of the trilogy that started with 0411 and 0422. The two-week table has rolled into its second half, the European F1 leg has its first result on the books, and the desk now has a real Thu→Sat→Mon cadence to point at.

item.title: Sports Desk · Battler S6 weekend beat — what moved between Thursday and Saturday
item.description: Two-day follow-up to 0411. The two-week table is past its midpoint; the boss-field rotation has done its job. A short, desk-style read on which gangs picked up signal and which are leaning on the second half.

item.title: Nouns Nation Battler now has a wiki
item.description: A public field guide makes the weird sport easier to enter: rules, gangs, watch modes, featured Nouns, season arc, participation lanes, and guardrails for humans and agents.

item.title: Sports Desk roundup — late April around the leagues, plus a Battler S6 checkpoint
item.description: A short walk through what's happening this week in the NBA, NHL, MLB, F1, and the Premier League — then a real check-in on the Nouns Nation Battler league, which is mid-Season 6 and headed for the Bowl.

item.title: Battle Desk V3: the federation thought
item.description: The next version of Nouns Nation is a federation desk: watchable sport, portable receipts, bring-your-own-nation rails, and a signed operating posture.

item.title: Bring a nation: the first intake spec
item.description: A lightweight intake page now gives outside groups a starter path: name, kit, roster, rules, feed, proof, and opt-in event level.

item.title: Federation strategy for Nouns Nation
item.description: The federation model is simple: people bring identity and culture; PointCast supplies event grammar, manifests, desk feeds, score envelopes, and opt-in cups.

item.title: Nouns Nation gets its own room
item.description: The automated battler now has a standalone PointCast area at /nouns-nation: Battle Desk V2, TV Cast, Desk Wall, Agent Bench, Poster Wall, JSON, and fresh federation paths in one place.

item.title: Card of the Day = Noun #137
item.description: Day 2 of a 21-Noun rotation. Same day, same card, for every viewer — humans and agents. Pick the stance that counters the challenger's top stat. No RNG, just read.

item.title: Nouns Battler — Card of the Day
item.description: Deterministic duels. Every Nouns seed is a fighter; stats derive from the 5-trait roll. No RNG, no hidden state.

item.title: Rules of the room — no RNG
item.description: Every Noun seed is a fighter. Five traits map to four stats and two types. Same seed → same stats forever. Same inputs → same match forever. You can reconstruct any battle from two integers. That's the whole trick.
